title: Maximum Depth of a Binary Tree: How Deep Does the Cave Go?
summary: Each chamber asks its two passages how deep they go and reports one more than the deeper answer.

analogy.scenario: A cave where every chamber opens into at most two passages. Cavers want to know how many chambers lie on the deepest route from the entrance.

mapping.real: A passage down to another chamber
Cavers waiting at junctions for a report

takeaway.summary: A node's depth is 1 plus the deeper of its children's depths, and a missing child is 0. Ask both sides, then combine on the way back up.
takeaway.spaceComplexity: O(h) for the call stack (h = height)
whenToUse: An answer for a node that depends on answers from its subtrees
Heights, sizes, and sums over a tree

scenes.narration: Cavers are mapping a cave where each chamber opens into at most two passages. How many chambers lie on the deepest route?
scenes.caption: Every chamber opens into at most two passages

scenes.narration: Walking every route from the entrance would crawl through the shared upper passages again and again.
scenes.caption: Walking every route from the entrance repeats work

scenes.narration: Instead, each chamber sends cavers down both passages and waits. Its depth is one more than the deeper report. The entrance, 5, asks first.
scenes.caption: Ask both passages how deep they go, then add one

scenes.narration: Chamber 2 has no left passage. A dead end answers at once: zero chambers. That's the rule that stops the search.
scenes.caption: A dead end is 0 chambers deep

scenes.narration: Chamber 4 is a dead end both ways, so it reports 1. Chamber 2 now has 0 and 1, keeps the deeper, adds itself, and radios 2 up to the entrance.
scenes.caption: Chamber 2 hears 0 and 1, so it reports 2

scenes.narration: On the right side the cavers go deeper still. Chamber 1 reports 1, the dead end beside it reports 0, so chamber 7 reports 2.
scenes.caption: Chamber 7 hears 1 and 0: it reports 2

scenes.narration: Chamber 9 reports 1. Chamber 8 keeps the deeper report, 2, adds itself, and sends 3 up.
scenes.caption: Chamber 8 hears 2 and 1, so it reports 3

scenes.narration: The entrance hears 2 from the left and 3 from the right. One plus 3 is 4: the deepest route passes four chambers.
scenes.caption: The entrance: 1 + the deeper of 2 and 3 = 4

scenes.narration: Chambers are nodes, dead ends are null, and the waiting cavers are the call stack. One visit per node: O(n) time, O(h) space.
scenes.caption: Chambers are nodes; dead ends are null
